about: What each GitHub App that works on Thornswood's repositories may do: the six Hermes Bots' two Apps, the box's admin App, the outside watcher's App and the engine pin robot (the redesign's part 20, plan lines 26 and 27, 1 Nov 2026). Each App holds exactly the permissions written here, at the level written, and no webhook events: what its job needs and nothing more. Every night scripts/dev/Check-AppPermissions.js reads each App from GitHub (GET /apps/<slug>) and names any permission or event the App has that this does not give it, and any this gives it that it lacks; the night is red until GitHub and this file agree. An App's permissions are changed only by Patrick, on its settings page, then accepted on each installation; the change is a pull request to this file first, with the reason in the permission's why, and a card on the report page with the clicks. Patrick's own agents are listed apart under patrick_agents: none of them holds a Bot App's key, and no Bot App is one of them. The repositories each App is installed on are written here for people to read; the nightly check cannot see an installation (only the App's own key can), so the box admin App's installation-repos ask and each Bot host's own check read those. A why is this file's own note.

apps.for: Bramble, the Hermes Bots' router: merges, Dev releases, labels for the others, and the workflow changes Magpie writes
apps.held_by: the tw-git broker on the Hermes VM, key readable by tw-git alone (Thornswood-Hermes thornswood_guard/policy.yaml, github_apps)

why.actions: Starts the release, deploy, Nexus and signing runs the policy lists (git_service.py start_run, POST actions/workflows/<file>/dispatches) and reads runs.
why.checks: Reads the check runs on a pull request's exact head before a merge (the policy's required checks). Never writes one.
why.contents: Pushes its own branches and Magpie's workflow branch, and merges (a merge writes the base branch).
why.issues: Comments, puts on and takes off claim labels, and makes the six claim labels.
why.metadata: Every App holds it; GitHub gives it read and nothing else.
why.pull_requests: Opens, edits and merges pull requests.
why.workflows: Pushes a change to .github/workflows that Magpie wrote, the one thing only Bramble's App may carry (RULES.md). GitHub refuses a workflow file change from a token without it.

apps.for: the five worker Bots: Rift, Sprocket, Echo, Magpie and Wisp
apps.held_by: the tw-git broker on the Hermes VM, key readable by tw-git alone (Thornswood-Hermes thornswood_guard/policy.yaml, github_apps)

why.actions: Reads runs and their logs for a pull request it opened. Starting a run is Bramble's alone.
why.checks: Reads the check runs on its own pull requests.
why.contents: Pushes the Bot's own branch. GitHub has no permission that pushes a branch but cannot merge, so the broker refuses a worker's merge (only Bramble merges) and main's ruleset refuses anything but a pull request with green checks.
why.issues: Comments, and puts on or takes off its own claim label.
why.metadata: Every App holds it; GitHub gives it read and nothing else.
why.pull_requests: Opens and edits its own pull requests.

apps.for: the box's admin service (scripts/vps/admin/admin.js): runner labels, the repository settings record, the About box and reading the Actions settings; the gate's Ship and box key tokens (ship-access.js, ops-access.js); and the Discord bot's GitHub token
apps.held_by: the box, its key's folder locked to SYSTEM, Administrators and the service's task (#4078)

why.actions: A Ship through the deploy gate (ship-access.js, #2841): starts thornswood-sign-manifest.yml on the fork and release-tag.yml and release.yml here, and reads their runs.
why.actions_variables: The settings ask reads variable names to compare with records/github-settings.json (#3534). Never a value.
why.administration: Runner labels and the runners' registration on Thornswood-Ops (ops-access.js runners), the rulesets, reporting, immutable releases, scanning, merge settings and collaborators of Thornswood and the fork (repo-settings), and the About box. Each ask takes a token with only the part it needs.
why.contents: Reads the records on Thornswood's main that every ask makes GitHub match, and the launcher a Ship takes.
why.environments: Renew-BoxKey.ps1 puts a box key into an environment secret of Thornswood-Ops (ops-access.js keys), which GitHub gives to Environments write alone; the settings ask reads environment names and where each deploys from (#3534).
why.issues: The Discord bot's token (#5260, Patrick's A): it posts Test tasks and known issues as comments and labels. Taken for Thornswood alone, every 30 minutes.
why.metadata: Every App holds it; GitHub gives it read and nothing else.
why.secrets: The settings ask reads repository secret names (#3534), never a value. Write was held only for go-public, which took the box's secrets off Thornswood before the flip on 30 Oct 2026 and is gone; an environment secret needs Environments write, not this.

apps.for: the outside watcher (.github/workflows/watch-outside.yml): reads whether the box's runners are online
apps.held_by: the watch environment of Thornswood, main only, where its key takes the place of RUNNER_TOKEN

why.administration: GitHub lists a repository's self-hosted runners only to administration read, and the box's runners are registered to Thornswood-Ops. Read alone: it changes nothing.
why.metadata: Every App holds it; GitHub gives it read and nothing else.

apps.for: the engine pin robot (.github/workflows/engine-pin.yml, #5148, #5256): pushes engine-pin/next and opens the pin's pull request
apps.held_by: the engine-pin environment of Thornswood, main only (PIN_APP_KEY)

why.contents: Force pushes the one branch engine-pin/next, which changes only the pin's paths, never a workflow.
why.metadata: Every App holds it; GitHub gives it read and nothing else.
why.pull_requests: Opens or updates the pin's pull request (Open-EnginePinPr.ps1).

apps.for: the org board "Thornswood To Do" (#1): board.yml moves cards and board-read.yml reads them (#5185)
apps.held_by: the board environment of Thornswood, main only (BOARD_APP_KEY)

why.issues: Reads and edits the issues the board's cards stand for, as board.yml asks (#5185).
why.metadata: Every App holds it; GitHub gives it read and nothing else.
why.organization_projects: Adds and moves cards on the org board; board-read.yml asks for read only when it mints its token.
why.pull_requests: Reads the pull requests that link to an issue on the board; it never writes one.

patrick_agents.name: Claude
patrick_agents.why: Patrick's own Claude sessions, through Anthropic's Claude App installed on all four repositories. It works as Patrick and is never a Bot: no Bot is run through it, and it holds no Bot App's key.

patrick_agents.name: Patrick's Hermes (my-hermes)
patrick_agents.why: Patrick's own agent on the Hermes VM, signed in to gh as EvilPatrick06. It is not one of the six Bots and cannot read the Bots' App keys, which only tw-git reads.
